owning_layer: CSGRS WASM native mesh error conversion
domain: Existing MeshJs fallible mesh methods backed by HypermeshResult; zero subdivision level; existing qualified query outcomes remain separate. No expansion of supported native geometry.
reproduction: preflight-v1: 31 real-JS observations on exact E29 committed-source artifacts; 28 string exceptions in Boolean, hull and zero-subdivision paths. Point queries returned three values; this probe does not establish or change their native input contract.
change: Route typed native mesh errors through the existing ValidationError category mapper and host GeometryError constructor; make the zero-level subdivision error use that constructor too.
migration: These formerly string-valued exceptions become ordinary Error objects carrying name=GeometryError and the existing six-way code union. Original diagnostic text remains the message. Callers should inspect error.code or error.message instead of assuming a thrown string.
certainty: A returned Unknown query remains Unknown without a certainty receipt. No policy, geometric operation, uncertainty decision or certainty receipt is changed.
acceptance: Real JS and compiled TypeScript consumers inspect errors after freeing all native handles; invalid operands paired with empty fail visibly, successful empty results compose and round-trip, all earlier binding consumers pass. Native lint/docs/affected checks and proportional artifact/runtime evidence are required before admission.
resource_limits: Only existing bounded diagnostic cases in tests; no claim of internally bounded arbitrary subdivision, total geometry work, retained bytes or cancellation.
